card.name: Digits inside decimal and strength numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit or the decimal point in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly dose strengths such as 6.25, 62.5, 87.5 or 0.83. It is strongest where the number is only partly written and the next digits are predictable.

modes.label: Decimal point in doses
modes.description: The period inside a dose number, where the next digits are expected to be like 25 or 5.
modes.example: patients may have their dose increased to 6<<.>>25, 12.5

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: A single digit that begins a strength or percentage, with more digits still to come.

card.plain: It fires partway through a dose number, such as the 6 in 62.5 mg, before the rest of the number is written.
